# API reference

<!-- Generated by TestReferenceDocs in platform/internal/cli; do not edit. -->

Every method is served by the Hub three ways, with the same token scopes and results:

- **REST/JSON**: `POST /agen.v1.HubService/<Method>` with a JSON body and `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- **gRPC / Connect**: service `agen.v1.HubService` (`spec/proto/agen/v1/hub.proto`).
- **MCP**: tool `<snake_case name>` at `/mcp` (streamable HTTP).

Fields use protojson names; `bytes` are base64; 64-bit integers may be strings.

## CancelTask

Cancel a task that has not finished; a running run is stopped.

Scope: `operator` · REST: `POST /agen.v1.HubService/CancelTask` · MCP tool: `cancel_task`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  |

## CreateApiToken

Create an API token with scopes (viewer, operator, approver, admin), optionally limited to namespaces.

Scope: `admin` · REST: `POST /agen.v1.HubService/CreateApiToken` · MCP tool: `create_api_token`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |
| `scopes` | list of string |  |
| `namespaces` | list of string |  |
| `ttlSeconds` | int32 |  |

## CreateDeployment

Deploy a bundle (files in bundleFiles or bundleText) as a new deployment. With validateOnly, only check it and return warnings.

Scope: `operator` · REST: `POST /agen.v1.HubService/CreateDeployment` · MCP tool: `create_deployment`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | string |  |
| `name` | string | Defaults to the bundle name. |
| `bundleFiles` | map&lt;string, bytes&gt; | The bundle files. The Hub validates and stores them as a Definition. |
| `bundleText` | map&lt;string, string&gt; | Bundle files as text (merged with bundle_files; easier to write by hand or from an MCP client than base64). |
| `validateOnly` | bool | Check the bundle and settings and return warnings without deploying. |
| `kind` | DeploymentKind | Overrides for values from x-agen/config.json; unset means use the bundle. |
| `scale` | ScalePolicy |  |
| `placement` | Placement |  |
| `budget` | Budget |  |
| `limits` | Limits |  |
| `triggers` | list of Trigger |  |

## GetTask

## SubmitTask

Queue a task (one agent run) for a deployment. Use conversationKey to continue an earlier conversation.

Scope: `operator` · REST: `POST /agen.v1.HubService/SubmitTask` · MCP tool: `submit_task`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ref` | DeploymentRef |  |
| `input` | string |  |
| `idempotencyKey` | string | Optional client key; resubmitting the same key returns the same task. |
| `conversationKey` | string | Tasks with the same key continue one conversation (and its memory). |
| `labels` | map&lt;string, string&gt; | Free-form labels, copied to runs, tool calls and delegated tasks. |
